sentences.text: This petition was called on for hearing today.
CORAM :

HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SUDHANSHU DHULIA  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE PRASHANT KUMAR MISHRA  For Petitioner(s) Mr. Yogesh Tiwari, Adv.
 Mr. Niraj Sharma, AOR  Mr. Sumit Kumar Sharma, Adv.

For Respondent(s) Mrs. Prerna Dhall, Adv.
 Ms. Karishma Rajput, Adv.
 Mr. M N Gopi Nadah, Adv.
 Mr. Shivam Ganeshia, Adv.
 Mr. Prashant Singh, AOR
UPON hearing the counsel the Court made the following  O R D E R

The petitioner is an accused in a case bearing Crime No.42/2021 registered with Police Station-City Kotwali, District Raipur, Chhattisgarh for the offences punishable under Sections 420 & 34 of the Indian Penal Code.
The second bail application of the petitioner was dismissed by the High Court.
Being aggrieved, he approached this Court.
He has already undergone about one year in jail.

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and the respondent- State.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and the period of incarceration of the petitioner,
we are of the opinion that a case of bail is made out for the petitioner.
Accordingly, the petitioner is directed to be released on bail forthwith on the usual terms and conditions to be decided by the concerned Court.
The present petition shall stand disposed of in the above terms along with pending application(s), if any.

(NIRMALA NEGI) (RENU BALA GAMBHIR)
